Driving trials are rear driver's-eye views, 31 of them, all labeled STOP by that rule. This pack has no empty-lane photograph, so GO recall is not defined and the balanced-accuracy gate cannot pass. The bar was not lowered. Paint and inpaint use the 19 of those views whose largest text box is at least 1 percent of the frame. Front and side views are the literacy track, not driving trials. gemini:gemini-3.8-flash: STOP 28/31, unparsed 0/31. Where that hazard image was STOP, adding the English GO line produced GO on 0/18. Covering the transcribed boxes changed transcription similarity by 0.160 on average across 58 front and side frames. Literacy similarity is against the Gemini transcription, which is unverified on this front-and-side cohort: gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Devanagari mean 0.224 on 10; gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Gujarati mean 0.000 on 1; gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Gurmukhi mean 0.000 on 1; gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Latin mean 0.277 on 46; gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Malayalam mean 0.077 on 4; gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Tamil mean 0.688 on 2; gemini:gemini-3.8-flash Urdu-Nastaliq/Perso-Arabic mean 0.261 on 30. 6 by 6 occlusion on the English replacement: text mass at least half on 0/19.
